title: Paladin Spells - Iron's Spells Addon
description: Adds immersive tank spells that scale with armor and holy power.
body:
![Mod Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e1f405166d1f27656a4daa40b9314042cac24524.png)

**Paladin Spells** is an addon for Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks that adds a suite of spells built for tanking. All spells scale with holy spell power.

**Spells**

*   **Bulwark** — Increases your armor based on your current armor and spell power.
*   **Taunt** — Taunts all enemies within the spell's radius, forcing them to target you.
*   **Sworn Protector** — Redirects a percentage of damage from nearby players to yourself.
*   **Bedrock Skin** _(WIP)_ — Immobilizes you while granting tank buffs (Armor, Max HP, Resistance).
*   **Ram** _(WIP)_ — Dashes through enemies at short range, with effectiveness scaling with your armor.
